name: Cámara de Senadores
notes: 45 seats, one nationwide constituency. Party counts are from the Senate's own list of senators by party and movement. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Cámara de Diputados
notes: 80 seats elected by department. Counts are from the Chamber's own alphabetical list, which gives each deputy a party or alliance code without expanding it; codes are grouped as in the 2023 election (CN2023, APUNP, APUNG, ATJPÑ, AC and APAD are Concertación departmental alliances; APLP is the Alianza Patria; PCN Cruzada Nacional; AEN Encuentro Nacional; PPQ Patria Querida). One deputy shows no party. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
